'''Through the Sea Thou Break''' is the Prologue in [[Chapter II]] of the [[Main Quests|Main Quest]].

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Black Shores]]
# Meet with Shorekeeper
# Find Aalto at the port
## (Optional) Fast Travel to the Port
# Talk to Brant
# Explore the troupe liner
# Arrive at the port
# Head to Ragunna City
## Talk to the gondolier
## (Optional) Talk to Cristoforo
# Travel to Ragunna on the liner

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing the step "Meet with Shorekeeper" will award the player {{Item|Beacon of the Past}} and {{Item|Invitation with a Fragrance}}.
* Completing the step "Travel to Ragunna on the liner" will award the player the ''[[Rover's Journey II]]'' [[trophy]] ''[[Papers, Please]]'' and {{Item|Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition)}}.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_14_2.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Behold, my friends! There she stands... Ragunna's Lighthouse of Dawn!
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_1.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Here we are! Ragunna's dock.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_12.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Oh, and do yourself a favor, try our [[Nectarwine]]. They say one drop of the "Gocce di Divino" will let you rendezvous with the Sentinel in your dreams...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_13.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Ha! That might just be your shortcut to seeing the Sentinel.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_14.ogg}} '''Brant:''' May the winds be in your favor!

:{{DIcon}} Let's take a look around first.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_22.ogg}} '''Order Deacon:''' Go forth, dear pilgrims, on your sacred journey. May the Sentinel guide you as it has guided the returning ships.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_23.ogg}} '''Order Deacon:''' Go forth, [[Andreas]]... "The Fool." The benevolent Primus has blessed you with this sacred pilgrimage. May you find the righteous path on your voyage.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_24.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' If you're all so righteous, why don't you join the pilgrimage yourselves!
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_25.ogg}} '''Order Deacon:''' Our duty remains here, to shepherd the lost. I grieve for you, my brother... for you have strayed from the truth.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_26.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' Ha... Haha... Truth... Don't make me laugh...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_27.ogg}} '''Order Deacon:''' Your transgression is absolved before the sacred [[Pilgrim's Sail]]. Go now, and board with humility.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_28.ogg}} '''???:''' Wait a moment, traveler... While you may harbor doubts, I implore you not to disrupt their pilgrimage.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_29.ogg}} '''???:''' Perhaps staying silent now would better serve your interests.
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, and you are?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_31.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Pardon my intrusion. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a modest playwright visiting Ragunna in search of inspiration for my latest work.
:{{DIcon}} I'm {{Rover}}.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_33.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I'm working on a play—tales of pilgrims striving to reach the Sentinel's promised land...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_34.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Word of a new Pilgrim's Sail about to depart brought me here. I came hoping to glean fresh ideas.
:{{DIcon}} That ship over there?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_36.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Yes. When Ragunnesi first settled here, they revered the Sentinel. The Carnevale was their tribute—a sacred rite to commune with it.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_37.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' It seemed the Sentinel Imperator preferred not to flaunt its power overtly to command the people's awe and respect.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_38.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Yet, amidst the Carnevale's revelry, it performed miracles, keeping the people aligned with its guidance.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_39.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Legend has it that, moved by its grace, the most devout believer braved storms and mists to find the Sentinel—thus was born the tradition of the Pilgrim's Sail.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_0_15_40.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Should you wish, I have more stories to tell.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_3.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' [[Fenrico]], the Enlightened One, present Primus of Ragunna, uncovered the path that leads to the high heaven, where the Sentinel imparts Their teachings to mortals.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_4.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Under his permission, pilgrims set sail for the Promised Land, their voices a symphony of hymns, hearts aflame with unwavering piety and hope.
:{{DIcon}} Piety... and hope?
:{{DIcon}} That... doesn't seem like what I just saw.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_7.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' I sense your doubt, and it's not unfounded. These pilgrims have little choice. After all, they are not counted among the Righteous but instead deemed the Fools by Ragunna's laws.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_8.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Whether a righteous soul clinging to hope amid hardship, or a lost fool floundering in waves of confusion, the audience always favors the former.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_9.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' I'm working on a play. Tells of pilgrims striving to reach the Sentinel's promised land.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_10.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' But to captivate, there must be twists. Perhaps, what awaits them is not the sweet salvation promised by their Sentinel, but...
:{{DIcon}} But what?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_12.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Hehe, who knows? Maybe treasures beyond count, or an unnamed beast lurking in the mist.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_13.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Or perhaps nothing but a forsaken shore. These are just initial musings. I need time to refine them.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_14.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Would you care to share your thoughts on the ending?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_15.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Should the story depict them as lost Fools facing their end in despair, or as wronged Righteous finally finding justice and redemption?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_16_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_16_F.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' What is more compelling to you, {{MC|m=sir|f=miss}}?

:{{DIcon}} The Righteous.
:{{DIcon}} To be honest... neither.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_20.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Ah, I see... Your comment is noted.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_1_21.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Until the Carnevale, guest from afar. I hope you enjoy the show.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_6.ogg}} '''Serious Acolyte:''' ...Approved. Welcome to Rinascita.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_7.ogg}} '''Serious Acolyte:''' Excuse me. First-time visitors must cooperate for inspection.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_8.ogg}} '''Serious Acolyte:''' Is this... a Reserved Terminal?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_9.ogg}} '''Serious Acolyte:''' Reserved Terminals should be declared upon entry. May I see your declaration form, please?
:{{DIcon}} ...I didn't know about that.
:{{DIcon}} I didn't declare it.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_12.ogg}} '''Serious Acolyte:''' These are the rules. I'll need you to cooperate.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_13.ogg}} '''Senior Acolyte:''' Forgive the inconvenience. By the Order's decree, all visitors must undergo customs clearance to ensure safety...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_14.ogg}} '''Senior Acolyte:''' ...Or, do you have a guarantor?
:{{DIcon}} (Show the invitation letter)
:{{DIcon}} Someone invited me here.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_17.ogg}} '''Serious Acolyte:''' Ah, I see you are a guest of the Montelli family. You are granted permission to bring your Reserved Terminal into Rinascita.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_18.ogg}} '''Serious Acolyte:''' We apologize for any trouble caused. All Echoes, even those in Reserved Terminals, are seen as Divine Envoys. Once they are baptized, they too will receive Imperator's blessings.
:{{DIcon}} Does that mean I can see the Sentinel in person?
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_21.ogg}} '''Senior Acolyte:''' Naturally! We are all "united" under the Sentinel's influence, free from "division."
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_22.ogg}} '''Senior Acolyte:''' The Sentinel is with you, me—all of us.
:{{DIcon}} I don't have any plans to do that.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_24.ogg}} '''Senior Acolyte:''' Rest assured, for our Sentinel embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. Laud Their name, and you will find solace!
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_23.ogg}} '''Senior Acolyte:''' Their presence is eternal in our hearts, guiding us always...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_26.ogg}} '''???:''' Preach with respect and patience, lest you induce doubt and confusion.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_27.ogg}} '''Serious Acolyte:''' Acolyte Phoebe.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_28.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' I'll take it from here. Greetings, esteemed guest. I am Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_29.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The city of Ragunna welcomes your arrival. Many visitors are here for the upcoming Carnevale. To ensure everyone enjoys the festival safely, the Order has tightened the customs procedures and added new regulations...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_30.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Some information might be overlooked on your declaration form. Please accept our apologies.
:{{DIcon}} It's okay. Rules are rules.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_33.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Thank you for your understanding. Please follow me.
:{{DIcon}} Can we enter the city now?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_6_34.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Certainly. Please follow me.
